title: Consent Collection
description: Personal data must not be processed without free, specific, informed and unambiguous consent of the Data Principal.
remediation: Implement a consent management system. Obtain explicit opt-in consent before collecting any personal data.

title: Data Minimization
description: Data Fiduciary must ensure personal data collected is limited to what is necessary.
remediation: Audit data collection practices. Remove unnecessary personal data fields.

title: Data Retention Policy
description: Personal data must be erased when the purpose for which it was collected is no longer served.
remediation: Define and implement a data retention schedule. Delete data post-purpose.

title: Notice to Data Principal
description: Data Fiduciary must provide itemized notice about what personal data is being collected and purpose.
remediation: Create and display a clear privacy notice at point of data collection.

title: Sensitive Personal Data Protection
description: Sensitive personal data (Aadhaar, financial data) requires additional protection measures.
remediation: Encrypt all sensitive personal data at rest and in transit. Implement access controls.

title: Children's Data Safeguards
description: Processing personal data of children requires verifiable parental consent.
remediation: Implement age verification mechanisms and parental consent workflows.

title: Cross-Border Data Transfer
description: Transfer of personal data outside India requires government-approved conditions.
remediation: Map all data flows. Ensure international transfers comply with government-notified restrictions.

title: Data Security Safeguards
description: Data Fiduciary must implement reasonable security safeguards to prevent personal data breach.
remediation: Deploy encryption, access controls, audit trails and breach notification procedures.

title: Right to Access & Correction
description: Data Principals have the right to access their data summary and request corrections.
remediation: Implement a self-service portal for data subjects to view, correct and delete their data.

title: Grievance Redressal
description: Data Fiduciary must have a mechanism for Data Principals to register complaints.
remediation: Appoint a Data Protection Officer (DPO) or designated grievance officer with published contact details.

title: DPO Appointment (Significant Data Fiduciary)
description: Significant Data Fiduciaries must appoint a Data Protection Officer based in India.
remediation: Appoint an India-resident DPO and register with the Data Protection Board.

title: Data Protection Impact Assessment
description: Significant Data Fiduciaries must conduct periodic Data Protection Impact Assessments.
remediation: Conduct and document DPIA for high-risk data processing activities annually.

title: Lawful Purpose of Processing
description: Personal data may be processed only for lawful purposes with consent or a legitimate use.
remediation: Document a legal basis for every data processing activity in a data processing register.

title: PII Masking in Non-Production Environments
description: Actual PII must not be used in development, testing or analytics environments.
remediation: Implement data masking / synthetic data generation pipelines for non-production environments.
